India's DPDPA
Regulations - DPDPA Digital Personal Data Protection Act
The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023 got enacted after more than a decade of effort to adopt a comprehensive data protection regime for India. It became a law on August 11, 2023, following assent by the President of India and publication in official gazette after clearing the Parliamentary hurdle the same week.
Learn More

New York's NY DFS
Regulations - NY DFS Cybersecurity Regulation
The New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) is the state agency responsible for regulating financial services and products, enforcing cybersecurity regulations, and protecting consumers and markets in New York.
Learn More
Get a Demo
EU's GDPR
Regulations - GDPR General Data Protection Regulation
GDPR is a data protection regulation that aims to safeguard the personal data of individuals in the EU by setting strict guidelines for its collection, processing, and storage, as well as providing individuals with more control over their data.
Learn More
Get a Demo
EU's AI Act
Regulations - European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act)
The EU Artificial Intelligence Act is a proposed regulation designed to ensure the safe and ethical development and use of artificial intelligence within the European Union.
Learn More
Get a Demo
California's CPRA
Regulations - CPRA California Privacy Rights Act
On July 8, 2022, the California Privacy Protection Agency commenced the formal rulemaking process to adopt regulations to implement the Consumer Privacy Rights Act of 2020 (CPRA).
Learn More
Get a Demo
California's CCPA
Regulations - CCPA California Consumer Privacy Act
The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) gives California residents more control over their personal information, requiring businesses to disclose data collection practices, offer opt-out options for data selling, and ensure data protection.
Learn More
Get a Demo
Canada's PIPEDA
Regulations - PIPEDA Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
PIPEDA is a Canadian law that requires private sector organizations to obtain consent, limit the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information, ensure its accuracy, safeguard it, provide individuals with access to their information, and designate individuals accountable for compliance.
Learn More
Get a Demo
Brazil's LGPD
Regulations - LGPD Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados
LGPD is the Brazilian data protection law that governs the processing of personal data, requiring consent, transparency, security measures, and granting individuals rights over their data, with penalties for non-compliance.
Learn More
Get a Demo
China's PIPL
Regulations - PIPL Personal Information Protection Law
PIPL is China's data protection law that regulates the processing of personal information, requiring consent, transparency, security measures, and granting individuals rights over their data, with penalties for non-compliance.
Learn More

Data Compliance Regulations
Exterro specializes in ensuring businesses meet both regulatory and corporate compliance standards regarding data management and protection.
Learn More
Regulations - DPDPA Digital Personal Data Protection Act
The Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) 2023 got enacted after more than a decade of effort to adopt a comprehensive data protection regime for India. It became a law on August 11, 2023, following assent by the President of India and publication in official gazette after clearing the Parliamentary hurdle the same week.
Learn More
Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
Exterro’s solution enables organizations to comply with Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), minimizing the risk of fines and penalties.
Learn More
Regulations - NY DFS Cybersecurity Regulation
The New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) is the state agency responsible for regulating financial services and products, enforcing cybersecurity regulations, and protecting consumers and markets in New York.
Learn More
Regulations - GDPR General Data Protection Regulation
GDPR is a data protection regulation that aims to safeguard the personal data of individuals in the EU by setting strict guidelines for its collection, processing, and storage, as well as providing individuals with more control over their data.
Learn More
Regulations - European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act)
The EU Artificial Intelligence Act is a proposed regulation designed to ensure the safe and ethical development and use of artificial intelligence within the European Union.
Learn More
Regulations - CPRA California Privacy Rights Act
On July 8, 2022, the California Privacy Protection Agency commenced the formal rulemaking process to adopt regulations to implement the Consumer Privacy Rights Act of 2020 (CPRA).
Learn More
Regulations - CCPA California Consumer Privacy Act
The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) gives California residents more control over their personal information, requiring businesses to disclose data collection practices, offer opt-out options for data selling, and ensure data protection.
Learn More
Regulations - PIPEDA Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
PIPEDA is a Canadian law that requires private sector organizations to obtain consent, limit the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information, ensure its accuracy, safeguard it, provide individuals with access to their information, and designate individuals accountable for compliance.
Learn More
Regulations - LGPD Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados
LGPD is the Brazilian data protection law that governs the processing of personal data, requiring consent, transparency, security measures, and granting individuals rights over their data, with penalties for non-compliance.
Learn More
Regulations - PIPL Personal Information Protection Law
PIPL is China's data protection law that regulates the processing of personal information, requiring consent, transparency, security measures, and granting individuals rights over their data, with penalties for non-compliance.
Learn More
